title: fora-music-v1 — the music.<field> keys of Offer.ext
description: Recording-discovery metadata for one music asset, carried as flat music.<field> keys in Offer.ext (and in the ext object of a catalog feed record). Every field is optional: an absent field means unknown, and an empty array means known to be empty. Other keys, including unknown music.* keys, are allowed, and consumers ignore them.

music.artist.description: Display credit. Case is preserved. It does not identify the publisher, the rights owner or a structured contributor. Descriptive only: not a matching input.

music.isrc.description: ISRC of the source recording, in the 12-character form without hyphens. For an excerpt or an edit it still names the source recording. Matched only by the music.isrc search filter, as an exact identifier.

music.instruments.description: Instruments heard in the asset. Category labels such as brass or strings are valid.

music.suitable_for.description: Editorial suitability, for example vlog, documentary or trailer. It does not give permission to use the asset; permission comes only from the license terms.

music.energy.description: Editorial energy level, independent of bpm.

music.vocals.description: True when the delivered asset contains any audible human voice: sung lyrics, wordless singing, choir or spoken word. False only when it contains no human voice.

music.bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute. A positive integer; fractional BPM is not supported.

music.duration_seconds.description: Duration of the delivered asset in seconds, which for an excerpt is the excerpt's duration.

Label.description: A canonical label: non-empty, with no leading or trailing whitespace (Unicode White_Space) and no upper-case or title-case letter (Unicode Lu, Lt). Consumers do no stemming and no singular/plural matching.
